events.title: Tori-no-Ichi Fair
events.summary: Stalls line the temple and shrine grounds selling ornate bamboo rakes decorated for good fortune and prosperity.

events.title: Murayama Tourism and Product Fair
events.summary: Regional specialities from Yamagata prefecture including local sake, fresh vegetables, imoni soup, and konjac are sold.

events.title: Asobo Festa
events.venue: Kotobuki Child and Family Support Center
events.summary: Children can play with various toys and join craft workshops in a family-friendly space.

events.title: Hagoita-ichi Battledore Market
events.summary: Stalls sell colorful traditional battledores featuring kabuki actors and pop culture figures.

events.title: Daikon Matsuri
events.summary: Simmered radish and sacred sake are served to visitors after a memorial service.
